coverage: First-round reference profile; identification and biographical details await review.

attestations.text: CHI Yün 紀昀 (曉嵐, 春帆, 石雲) Aug. 3, 1724–1805, Mar. 14, official and scholar, was a native of Hsien-hsien, Chihli. When he passed first in the provincial examination for chü-jên in 1747 he attracted the attention of many older scholars.
紀昀，字曉嵐，直隸獻縣人。

westernYears.note: Western year as printed; not a resolved Chinese civil year.
Western year as printed; not a resolved Chinese civil year.

accounts.evidence: 紀昀，字曉嵐，直隸獻縣人。乾隆十九年進士，改庶吉士。散館授編修。再遷左春坊左庶子。京察，授貴州都勻府知府。高宗以昀學問優，加四品銜，留庶子。尋擢翰林院侍讀學士。前兩淮鹽運使盧見曾得罪，昀為姻家，漏言奪職，戍烏魯木齊，釋還。上幸熱河，迎鑾密雲，試詩，以土爾扈特全部歸順為題，稱旨，复授編修。
